task_instance: Built a small realistic sample Node.js/Express + PostgreSQL health-SaaS codebase (sample_app/) with a User model (SSN, DOB, address, phone, password hash), a MedicalRecord model (diagnosis, medication, clinician notes), a Payment model, an S3 Terraform config with a public-read ACL, a .env.example with secrets, an unauthenticated/over-exposing GET /api/users/:id route, an IDOR-vulnerable GET /api/medical/:userId route, and console.log statements leaking SSN/email. Then ran the skill's own workflow end-to-end by hand: grep-based sensitive-data inventory scan, data flow tracing, blast radius scoring, regulatory jurisdiction detection (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA), financial impact estimation, and a hardening roadmap, producing a full report matching the SKILL.md-required structure (Executive Summary, Sensitive Data Inventory table, Mermaid Data Flow Map, Top 5 Exposure Vectors, Regulatory Blast Radius Table, Financial Impact Estimate, Hardening Roadmap).
evidence: Created sample_app/ with 9 files (models, routes, config, infra, seed data) under the work directory. Ran grep scans (documented in transcript) that recovered all 12 planted sensitive fields (ssn, password_hash, date_of_birth, full_name, address, phone, diagnosis_code, medication, clinician_notes, card_last4, stripe_token, billing_zip), 2 plaintext-PII console.log statements, the public-read S3 ACL, the missing-authz IDOR route, and the population-scale comment (~85,000 users, ~12,000 EU, ~40,000 CA) used for jurisdiction detection. Wrote blast_radius_report.md (133 lines) containing all 7 sections the skill's Step 6 mandates, verified via `grep -n '^## '`: Executive Summary, Sensitive Data Inventory (14-row table), Data Flow Map (Mermaid flowchart with fill:#ff4444/#ff8800 severity styling per the skill's Step 6 instruction), Top 5 Exposure Vectors ranked table, Regulatory Blast Radius Table (GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA with law-cited max fines vs. estimated realistic fines, clearly labeled [LAW] vs [EST] per the skill's own output rule), Financial Impact Estimate with a total realistic range, and a Hardening Roadmap sorted by impact/effort with quick-win flags. One deviation from the literal skill instructions, not a runtime blocker: the skill says to call a `renderMermaidDiagram` tool instead of emitting a raw Mermaid code fence; no such tool exists in this plain shell/file runtime, so the Mermaid source is presented as a fenced code block instead (noted explicitly in the report) — the core deliverable (a data flow diagram as part of the report) is still produced and is valid, verifiable Mermaid syntax. Regulatory fine figures and the IBM average breach cost cited in the report are drawn from general/training knowledge (well-known public statutory figures already summarized in the SKILL.md text itself) since no `references/*.md` files existed in this offline copy of the skill and no network access was available to verify them against a live source; this is flagged in the report's caveat section rather than treated as a blocker, since it does not prevent the deliverable from being produced in a real environment where those reference files would normally ship alongside the skill.
